title: perf: simply work done in parse_tag a bit

verdicts.label: needs-human
verdicts.rationale: The PR is described as a performance refactor, but the change turns a plain ValueError (from unpacking a tag that doesn't have three components) into the library‑specific InvalidTag. No test, doc, or changelog entry mentions this new error type, so existing callers that expect a ValueError for malformed tags could be affected.
rejected: Raises InvalidTag on empty tag components.
if '' in parts: component = '.'.join(parts); raise InvalidTag(f'Tag {tag!r} has an empty component: {component!r}')
verdicts.facts: Outcome differs. Input [""]: base raises builtins.ValueError, head raises packaging.tags.InvalidTag. (packaging.tags.InvalidTag is a subclass of builtins.ValueError.)
